description.narrative: This workplan aims to strengthen youth engagement and evidence-based policymaking across South Asia through a combination of research, assessment, and capacity-building activities. It will include an ethnographic study of indigenous and local youth living in and around UNESCO Biosphere Reserves to better understand their aspirations, livelihoods, knowledge systems, and contributions to sustainable development and conservation. The workplan will also support the implementation of the Youth as Researchers (YAR) initiative in Bangladesh and pilot UNESCO’s Toolbox for Youth Policy and Programming to enhance youth-responsive policies and programmes. Together, these activities will generate new evidence, amplify youth voices, and inform more inclusive and effective approaches to youth engagement, sustainable development, and policy design in the region.
